name: Halo
author: byo-pop
description: A game mode on a ring: the board is 60 cells around a 2 x 2 hub, and the only move is a twist. Click where four gems meet to turn them clockwise; a right click turns them the other way. Shapes forge the power gems: four gems of one colour in a 2 x 2 square forge a flame gem, which blows up the 3 x 3 square around it, and runs that cross join into an L, T or plus and forge a lightning gem, which clears its row and column; straight runs only score. Runs count on the diagonals too, for a little bonus. Nine kinds of gem. Gems fall past the hub, and the game ends when no twist makes a match. Uses its own high-score table. Turn on one game mode at a time.
